decisions.reason: The existing message-187 MODIFY already captures the Thursday-morning submission deadline, five-clip batch, delivery channel, and late-submission consequence; the publication schedule requires no additional workflow change.
The existing message-187 MODIFY already records that all five clips require client review and approval before Friday publication.
The source-selection changes are independently stated and already captured by the candidate's message-187 MODIFY; the Friday publication schedule adds no further source-selection change.

The message directly restates the complete-moment standard and adds audience comprehension in an existing candidate Event, but the publication schedule itself does not further change this content requirement.
A five-clip batch scheduled for possible Friday publication does not change or explicitly resume the deferred 100-approved-clips-per-month quota.

The message directly applies the existing clean-editing standard to the current batch, and its supplied same-message Event already captures the relevant context; publication timing adds no further change.
The white-text rule is already represented and the existing message-187 Event applies it to monthly production; the publication schedule does not alter caption styling.
The message restates the already-current 45-to-60-second duration range without changing it, and the Friday publication schedule has no additional duration effect.
The current batch's delivery and publication schedule does not change Lead Clipper advancement, training, compensation, or responsibilities.
The qualification had already been successfully completed before this source message; scheduling the first real publication batch does not independently change the qualification requirement.
The message's instruction to use B-roll where it strengthens the message concerns B-roll usage, not a renewed or modified source-moment selection standard.
